# Tools CLI - Interactive CLI Companion

An interactive, high-fidelity developer dashboard designed to help master advanced command line interface (CLI) engines (Git, Ollama, FFmpeg, yt-dlp, Docker, jq, tmux, adb, ImageMagick, etc.).

## Supported Engines Cheatsheet & Links
You can navigate directly to specific builders and modules using the links below:
- [Tools CLI Home](https://tools-cli.konshu.in): Main interactive developer dashboard overview.
- [About Tools CLI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/about): Learn more about the CLI dashboard architecture and mission.
- [Git Builder](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/git): Staging, branching, and commit rollback configurator.
- [Ollama AI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/ollama): Local LLM model download and parameter prompt builder.
- [FFmpeg Renderer](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/ffmpeg): Audio/video conversions, compression filters, and crops.
- [yt-dlp Downloader](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/yt-dlp): High-speed media extraction and download script builder.
- [Python & Pip](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/python-pip): Virtual environments manager and compiler config setups.
- [Node & NPM](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/node-npm): Dependency resolve scripts and package setups.
- [Vercel CLI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/vercel): Server deployments, preview links, and environment bindings.
- [Gemini CLI](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/gemini): Google Gemini API configurations and parameters setup.
- [ADB Tools](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/adb): Android debugging command generator and terminal utilities.
- [ImageMagick](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/magick): Image cropping, sizing, and format conversion scripts.
- [CLI Utilities](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/utils): Stream processor configs (jq, ripgrep, tmux, curl, docker).
- [CLI Knowledge Quiz](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/quiz): Multi-choice interactive terminal syntax test.
- [Terms of Service](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/terms): User guidelines and MIT license info.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tools-cli.konshu.in/privacy): Local storage usage and privacy statements.

## Technology Stack
- **Framework**: Vite + React 19 (JavaScript)
- **Routing**: React Router v7 (`BrowserRouter` history-based routing)
- **Icons**: Lucide React
- **Deployment**: Vercel (static SPA deployment with rewrite rules)

## Key Architecture
- **Single Page Application Routing**: Converted from hash-based routing (`/#/tool`) to clean path-based routing (`/tool`). Supports full history fallbacks locally via Vite dev/preview server and in production using `vercel.json` rewrites.
- **Modular SEO**: Dynamically updates HTML titles, meta descriptors, Open Graph tags, canonical URLs, and structured JSON-LD schemas using a reusable custom hook `useSEO` located in `src/hooks/useSEO.js`.

## Codebase Structure
```text
src/
├── App.jsx                 # Layout wrapper, routes declaration, and global state
├── App.css                 # Base container layouts
├── index.css               # Styling variables, color themes, and pulsing status dot
├── main.jsx                # App mounter wrapped with BrowserRouter
├── hooks/
│   └── useSEO.js           # Reusable custom SEO hook for metadata and JSON-LD
├── components/
│   ├── Sidebar.jsx         # Navigation sidebar and category filtering
│   ├── DashboardHome.jsx   # Grid of available tools, bookmarks, and copy histories
│   ├── ToolDetail.jsx      # Flowchart concept maps, interactive commands builder, and cheat sheets
│   ├── Console.jsx         # Mock terminal emulator screen
│   ├── Quiz.jsx            # Multi-choice interactive terminal quiz
│   ├── Footer.jsx          # Policy links and project credits
│   └── icons.jsx           # SVG wrappers for non-standard symbols (e.g. GithubIcon)
└── data/
    └── toolsData.js        # The single-source-of-truth file containing all CLI parameters and choices
```

## Adding a New Engine
1. **Define Data**: Update `src/data/toolsData.js` by appending a tool config object inside the `toolsData` array. Include metadata, options, command generator, and simulated terminal outputs.
2. **Icons**: Define the tool icon switch case in the `getToolIcon` helper inside `src/components/Sidebar.jsx` and `src/components/DashboardHome.jsx`.
3. **Accent styling**: Append CSS variables in `src/index.css` for `--accent-color` and `--accent-glow`.

## Development Commands
- **Local Dev Server**: `npm run dev`
- **Linter Checks**: `npm run lint`
- **Compile Production Assets**: `npm run build`
- **Serve Production Assets Locally**: `npm run preview`
- **Single-page Fallback Serve**: `npx serve -s dist`
